MixDesk bundles the official Windows x64 yt-dlp.exe release 2026.08.19.
The executable is unmodified; see SHA256SUMS for its checksum.

Upstream project and release:
https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp
https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2026.08.19

The official PyInstaller executable includes third-party GPLv3+ code;
the combined executable is distributed under GPLv3 or later.
See LICENSE.GPL-3.0.txt and the upstream distribution and build documentation:
